question_text: Tell me about a time you resolved a conflict between two engineers who disagreed on the technical approach.
ideal_hints: Active listening demonstrated · Technical discussion facilitated not imposed · Data-driven or objective tie-breaker used · Team cohesion maintained after decision · Quantified outcome stated (timing, metric, or team impact)
follow_up: What would you do differently if you faced the same situation today?

question_text: Describe a situation where you had to influence a decision without having direct authority.
ideal_hints: Clear articulation of the decision at stake · Stakeholders identified and mapped · Persuasion through data or evidence, not authority · Clear ownership of the outcome · Measurable business or technical impact described
follow_up: How did you handle it when people did not agree with your recommendation?

question_text: Tell me about a time you made a significant mistake. What happened and what did you learn?
ideal_hints: Honest ownership of the mistake without deflection · Clear description of impact · Concrete corrective actions taken · Systemic fix implemented to prevent recurrence · Evidence that the lesson was actually applied later
follow_up: Did you share what you learned with your team?

question_text: Tell me about a time you delivered a project under tight deadlines or with limited resources.
ideal_hints: Prioritization methodology explicitly stated · Trade-off decisions explained with rationale · Stakeholder communication described · Delivery confirmed with timeline · Quality or technical debt implications acknowledged
follow_up: Were there any quality trade-offs you had to make? How did you handle them?

question_text: Describe a time you designed or significantly improved a system that needed to scale.
ideal_hints: Scalability requirements quantified (users, throughput, latency) · Architecture choices explained with alternatives considered · Bottlenecks identified proactively · Monitoring and observability addressed · Real production outcome described
follow_up: What would you change about the design if you had to do it again at 10x scale?

question_text: Tell me about a time you worked with a cross-functional team to deliver a product feature.
ideal_hints: Specific cross-functional partners named (PM, design, data) · Communication cadence described · Blockers identified and addressed · Individual contribution clear · Launch outcome quantified
follow_up: What was the most challenging communication problem you had with the non-technical members?

question_text: Tell me about a time you had to make a decision with incomplete or ambiguous information.
ideal_hints: Explicit acknowledgment of ambiguity · Information gathering steps taken · Decision framework or criteria used · Risk assessed and communicated · Outcome evaluated retrospectively
follow_up: Looking back, do you think you made the right call? What would you do differently?

question_text: Describe a time you mentored or helped develop a junior team member.
ideal_hints: Specific gap identified in the mentee · Tailored approach described not generic advice · Regular check-ins or feedback loops established · Measurable improvement in mentee observed · Long-term impact on mentee career described
follow_up: How did your approach change when you realized the initial approach was not working?

question_text: Tell me about a time you proposed and implemented an innovative solution that others had not considered.
ideal_hints: Problem clearly defined before solution · Why existing solutions were insufficient · Creative leap explained · Stakeholder buy-in obtained · Measurable outcome from implementation
follow_up: How did you get buy-in from skeptical stakeholders?

question_text: Tell me about a time you took ownership of something that was not technically your responsibility.
ideal_hints: Clear explanation of why you stepped up · Actions taken beyond your defined role · Impact on the team or project from your intervention · Recognition of boundaries while still helping · Outcome that would not have happened without you
follow_up: How did your team or manager respond to your taking ownership?
